method: Manual visual reading of every original PDF page (33 pages), with complete tile crops and room associations verified against publisher artwork.
notes: All 33 source pages reviewed; Creative, Louvers and Bosta specimen boards are linked to the matching room photograph on the following page.
Texture closeups have decorative cut-out edges and are not treated as complete tiles. Full rectangular specimen faces are used instead.
Manufacturer finish abbreviations GLR (R10) and Structure Matt (R10) are preserved as printed.
